record.name: Zoho Cliq
record.one_liner: Zoho Cliq offers team chat, communication software, and developer APIs using OAuth2 authentication.

auth.notes: Uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow via the Zoho accounts server to obtain access tokens.

access.notes: Users can sign up for free accounts and register apps in the API console.

api_surface.notes: The pages mention REST APIs and endpoints for authentication, but do not provide details on specific GraphQL or webhook implementations.

mcp.notes: No Model Context Protocol implementation is detailed for Cliq in the provided text, though Zoho Developer lists MCP generally.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve account creation combined with standard OAuth2 documentation makes integration buildable.

evidence.claim: Zoho Cliq is a team chat and communication software with an admin panel and developer platform.
Server-based apps use the OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow to obtain access tokens.
Provides free sign up for Zoho Cliq.
Details exchanging authorization codes for access tokens at the Zoho accounts server endpoint.
